# marches with the empire: an inner province not on the civil course (the civil types do not join wars, the first
# maker's subject_types), or a middle-circle subject of a type that answers the muster (gen_territory_middle.py

    OR = {
        AND = { oe_sx_inner = yes NOT = { oe_ts_course_civil = yes } }
        AND = { is_subject_of = c:BYZ OR = { is_subject_type = oe_rome_sub is_subject_type = oe_rome_sub_II is_subject_type = oe_roman_march is_subject_type = oe_arabian_kingdom is_subject_type = oe_black_sea_kingdom is_subject_type = oe_persian_empire is_subject_type = oe_hungarian_dominion is_subject_type = oe_german_kingdom is_subject_type = oe_german_holy_empire } }

# has a seat in the senate (gen_territory_senate.py)

# Character scope. Holds the despot's rank: rules an inner despotate, or bears the dignity oe_tw_title_despotes
